# Atilade Gabriel Oke

## Summary
Atilade Gabriel Oke builds cool stuff for people and agents. Analyst, Data & AI at ION in London. Founder of Refinery, which proves AI changes to enterprise COBOL are safe to deploy. BEng Electrical & Electronic Engineering, University of Manchester (2026). 8x hackathon winner and #1 IBM Z Student Ambassador 2025-26.
